clips.title: Quest text
paras: I am feeling much better already. I have some skill with the arcane arts and we are but a short distance from Valanaar. I can make it on my own. More important than my safety, however, is how close to Valanaar these shrieklings have nested and the danger they pose. If you would be so kind, please head back inside and take the head of that beast!
After it's done, you'll find me back in Valanaar. I need to report to the Supreme Magister what occurred here and the status of my mission.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
